query.name: net.cdolinc.studentinfo.prescription.medications
query.description: Lists the prescription medication records for one student.
query.sql: SELECT students.dcid, u_fb_medications.id, u_fb_medications.studentsdcid, u_fb_medications.name, u_fb_medications.dosage, u_fb_medications.dosage_units, u_fb_medications.frequency_taken FROM students INNER JOIN u_fb_medications ON u_fb_medications.studentsdcid = students.dcid WHERE students.dcid = :studentsDCID ORDER BY UPPER(u_fb_medications.name), u_fb_medications.id
